notes.title: Development Update for Magical Princess
notes.content:
Hello again from the Magical Princess development team!

We apologize for the lack of progress updates over the past several months, and we appreciate your patience and understanding. With only three core team members, we've been extremely busy handling a wide variety of tasks. Despite these challenges, we're making steady progress toward completion!



Current Development Progress (approximate):


Game System: 90%

The core rasing system is complete, and we're currently fine-tuning various elements such as battles and skill trees.

Scenario: 100%

The main storyline, events, and dialogues have all been completed.

Illustrations: 70%

The artwork covers a vast range of categories, including characters, outfits for dress-up, monsters, items, backgrounds, and event CGs. Although there's an large number of illustrations required, we're steadily approaching completion.

Balancing: 60%

We're carefully adjusting various elements, including classes, part-time jobs, battles, skill trees, cooking, items, and interactions with romanceable characters, to ensure a balanced gameplay.

Other Tasks: 60%

Music production, character voice recordings, and translation work are underway. Due to the massive volume of scenario content, voice recordings and translations are taking longer than initially anticipated, but they're steadily moving forward.



Over the past few months, we've finally begun to see a clear path to completion. We plan to sequentially release more detailed information soon, so please look forward to it!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/c188e67dc678cb81155239a8e6508a289979e9fb.png"]


Additional Preview of In-Development Game Screens!

This time, we're sharing some in-development game screens, including brand-new scenes. We hope these images will give you a clearer sense of our current progress.

Please note that the text in these screenshots is in Japanese, as translations have not yet been finalized. Rest assured, the full game will support English and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
